releaseNotes:
• Multi-Word Die-Cut Magic Stickers: Full support for 3, 4, 5+ word phrases in Sinhala & English with smart 2x2 grid balancing and iterative dynamic auto-scaling preventing clipping
• Crystal-Clear PSB Status Icon: Bold, frame-free vector typography ensuring the PSB icon is sharp and clearly visible in Android status bar notifications
• Language Switch Hint Fix: Fixed letter corruption bug when switching between Sinhala and English layouts
• Single Keyboard Window Guard: Safe view detachment and window state handling preventing duplicate or overlapping keyboard instances
• Zero-Telemetry Crash & Bug Reporter: Automatic diagnostic report generation with 1-tap WhatsApp/Share log sharing in Settings
